constraints: Persist links and clicks in SQLite.
Reserved aliases such as api, health, and docs are rejected.
Idempotency-Key replays the original create when the payload matches.

acceptance: the target must be http or https; the javascript scheme and other schemes are rejected; optional alias and optional expiration are accepted.
functional_requirements.statement: Create a short link with POST /api/v1/urls.

acceptance: a missing code returns 404; an expired or disabled code returns 410; an active code returns 302.
functional_requirements.statement: Redirect with GET /{code} and record the click.

acceptance: the payload includes the target, expiry, and status.
the payload includes total clicks, last access, top referrers, and clicks per day.
a later redirect stops and metadata stays available.
the database is checked before the service reports ready.

out_of_scope: Accounts, API keys, and custom domains.
problem_statement: Clients need a durable short link for an http or https URL. A recipient follows the short link. An operator needs click analytics and a way to turn a link off.
title: URL shortener service
